findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded for controller requests
findings.body: `translate` still only calls `load_locale(config.locale)` for the current locale, and the only place that calls `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is `ApplicationController#set_locale` (application_controller.rb:159). Because the patched `load_translations` forces explicit loading and `load_locale` is the only loader, any translation performed outside a web request (Sidekiq/background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, the console, or `I18n.with_locale` / `I18n.t(key, locale: x)` inside a request) will try the fallback chain (`SiteSetting.default_locale`, `:en`) without those locale files ever having been loaded. When the requested locale lacks a key, the fallback lookup then misses and the caller gets a missing translation/raw key instead of the site-default/English string. For example, a job running under `I18n.locale = 'de'` on a site whose default locale is `'fr'` never loads `fr`, so a missing German key cannot fall back to French. Ensure the whole fallback chain is loaded whenever a locale is loaded (e.g. make `load_locale`/`translate` call `I18n.ensure_loaded!` for each entry of `I18n.fallbacks[locale]`), not only from the controller before_filter.

findings.title: Fallback chain recomputes a SiteSetting lookup on the translation hot path
findings.body: `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` calls `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` on every `I18n.translate`/`I18n.exists?` that reaches the backend (i.e. every translation not served from the translate accelerator's LRU cache), and this `[]` override calls `SiteSetting.default_locale` each time. That turns a previously pure in-memory fallback-list lookup into a site-setting lookup on the hot translation path and, via `set_locale`, once per request. It also means an early `I18n.t` (boot initializers, asset precompilation, rake tasks, console before the DB/Redis are available) now attempts to read site settings and can raise instead of simply returning a translation. Memoize the default locale / compute the chain once per locale and invalidate it on reload.

findings.title: No tests for the new fallback behavior, which is now enabled in every environment
findings.body: The PR changes translation resolution globally (fall back to the site default locale, then English) but adds no specs covering `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, the fallback ordering, or `ensure_loaded!`. Additionally, `I18n.fallbacks = FallbackLocaleList.new` runs in every environment, while the `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` lines that were removed only existed in production/profile/Cloud66, so fallbacks now also apply in test/development where they were previously unset. Tests that assert a missing key is returned verbatim, or that a given locale has no translation, will now silently receive the site-default/English string. Add tests for the new fallback chain and confirm the intended test-environment behavior.
